Then reason: The question only asks about box III. After the reservoir is built, the water surface in the reservoir area expands, most directly causing evaporation from the water surface in the reservoir area to strengthen; the increase in evaporation amount provides more water vapor, and thus can explain “precipitation around the lake increases.” Therefore, box III corresponds to “the evaporation amount in the reservoir area increases.”
